sections.heading: Tetsoperator
sections.content: The Tets operator allows you to convert particle shape meshes into tets.

sections.heading: Tets
sections.content:
SDF radius: the cell radius of the signed distance field used to create the tet meshes.Particle per tet: when enabled, individual tets will be split out into new, separate particles.

SDF radius: the cell radius of the signed distance field used to create the tet meshes.

Particle per tet: when enabled, individual tets will be split out into new, separate particles.

sections.heading: Tet meshes
sections.content: Material ID: the material ID to assign to tets, prior to any material ID inheritance.

sections.heading: Base UVWs
sections.content:
Base UVW coordinates are box-projected coordinates that are assigned prior to any surface inheritance calculations.

Size: the real-world size of the box projection.

sections.heading: Surface Inheritance
sections.content:
UVWs: the outer surface of the generated tets will inherit UVWs from the source mesh.Material IDs: the outer surface of the generated tets will inherit Material IDs from the source mesh.

UVWs: the outer surface of the generated tets will inherit UVWs from the source mesh.

Material IDs: the outer surface of the generated tets will inherit Material IDs from the source mesh.
